principles.text: Forced rest day: after weeks of trading too aggressively and badly, commit in advance to zero trades no matter what, and use the day to practice patience. Missing a 'perfect' short (semis) is accepted as the punishment for earlier impatience.

Semis/memory pushed higher with follow-through but he already missed the entry, so it is not a time for longs; many names are still under the clouds rallying INTO moving averages, and SMH is still under the weekly 9 - needs more upside proof.
You don't have to be a genius or trade perfectly; how you handle the difficult periods matters more than the easy ones when everyone makes money. Improve bit by bit.
Undercut-and-rally buys: does NOT wait for the candle close, and may not even wait for the reclaim of the key level if price overshoots support - buys the reversal on the 1/5/15-minute chart.
Shorting near the high of day above all the EMAs and VWAP (SPCX post-IPO) is possible but harder and lower win rate; it needs a nailed entry near the open / swing high.

Chart-study method: scan a stock's meaningful trends and ask where the best risk/reward entry was that is (a) replicable and (b) identifiable in real time, not hindsight. Form a hypothesis (e.g. breakout after a pin bar), test it across the same stock's trends and then across tens/hundreds of stocks; discard rules with many counter-examples. His shift from breakouts to pullbacks came from seeing repeated wicks into the 9/21 that continued higher, giving a lower entry than the breakout; then define the intraday entry as a lower-timeframe breakout. Easier framing: 'where can I set the tightest stop?'

A quick push into the 50 EMA after a fast downtrend with no consolidation and no support shown at the rising EMAs, prior lows or gaps: sell at least 50% at the 50 EMA (odds of resistance there and at the weekly 9 are high); he wouldn't buy that pullback at all, and might short it.

Data-center names locked out higher (IREN strong), LITE forming a VCP/cup-with-handle on daily and weekly with low volume (fine), software weak and not filling the gap down (PATH toward the 50 EMA), silver rejected overnight.
Crypto pullback: next levels of interest are the weekly 21 or 9 (his chart's 13/30 EMA equivalents).
